speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I have read it as it is written, and I am not sorry for the relish. The curses were in their places. A soft reading would have been a lie told in a loud room, and I do not tell that lie.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It was the right hardness, Master Thwaite. Mark me. The house is fish from this dinner. I did not salt Monday to look ready, and I am not going to look keener than the curate who did the work.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Are we in the curses, sir? I stood still. I should like to know if still was enough, or if the words were for the people who coughed.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Still is not a virtue, Alse, but it is a beginning. The curses are for the parish that hears them. You heard them. That is more than the beds did. I am not grading the coughs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We heard them. The company does not play today, because the day says it does not. I have not come into this porch to argue another house. The reading is done. I am not asking you to do it again for my sake.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then do not. I read what is appointed, and I enjoyed the appointment. A Christian may enjoy a true sentence. I shall not pretend I stumbled over the sharp ones. They are the point of the morning.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Enjoy it while it is hot, Master Thwaite. My lodger enjoys sentences too, and I have never found that a reason to trust the dinner. Alse, the fish is at home. It is not in the aisle, whatever the sermon-appetite in this porch suggests.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the fish the punishment, mistress, or only the beef we are not having? I can bear a rule better if I know which thing is the rule.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The beef had Sunday, and it had yesterday. Today is the other thing. You will not get a pancake out of me. You will not get a plot out of me either. I am going to Shoreditch to look at a cold stage. I am not going there to play.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Look, then. Do not bring me a playhouse story in place of a grace. Three days, you said on Sunday. The three days are spent. I counted them on my own fingers, which are sufficient, and one of them is short of loaf already.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The glass is not needed today. The day is the day. Ash Wednesday is not a riddle and not a sum. Go to your cold stage, Master Shakespeare. I shall not read the commination a second time for a man who has already heard it and wants it quieter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was here for it, and I am not asking for it again. Once was the relish. I saw you enjoy the sharp sentences. I will not carry them to the company. They have enough of their own without yours.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I explain it to Gib? He was on the book. He will think the house has gone strange if the beef stops and nobody says why.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will explain nothing to the cat. The fish will explain itself when it is on the board. Master Shakespeare, wipe your feet. This is honest mud. I will not have you turn it into a meaning on my stair later.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am wiping them. Shoreditch will add its own dirt, and I will wipe that too. I will be back before evening prayer. If the stage is only cold, the news is only cold. I can live with a short news.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Evening prayer is evening prayer. It is not a second commination, whatever a long face hopes. We shall be brief. You have heard me say so on a Sunday, and you have taken no profit from it, which is why a Wednesday may hear it too.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The loaf is still a penny and a finger short. The fast does not lengthen it. I say so in case anyone in this porch means to call hunger a new invention of the morning. It is the same loaf.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I measured it against the notch before you were down the stair. You need not preach my own board back to me. A finger short is my fact. You may borrow it. You may not improve it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: A finger is a small start to a long fast, sir. I am not complaining. I am measuring, as the mistress measures. I like to know the size of a rule.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Forty days are not a finger. Do not let a player comfort you with the loaf. Comfort was not the office. The office was the reading, and the reading has been read, and I am pleased with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not comforting. I am going. The Theatre is cold, the company is idle, and the idle is the obedience. I will not open the house to feel busy on a day that has told us to stop.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Busy is how a player slips past a Wednesday. Be cold, and be back for your fish, and do not bring me a story instead of an appetite. I have the appetite arranged. I am not arranging your acts.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will set the fish. I will not set an extra trencher for a story. If he comes back with nothing to tell, that is less work for the board.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then the porch is finished. God keep you through the salt. I have enjoyed my work. I am going to enjoy my dinner, which is also fish, and I shall not apologise for either enjoyment.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Fish, then, and no second reading. Alse, the heel of the loaf comes home with us. I am not leaving it in a porch to become somebody's parable.
